stories.title: Defining global leadership in AI at Trump-Xi summit
stories.summary: Former U.S. deputy national security advisor Anne Neuberger is watching for signs of competition and cooperation on artificial intelligence at President Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping's summit this week.

stories.title: President Trump navigates tough political waters with UNGA, Xi visit and AI
stories.summary: President Trump has a big week on the international stage, from the United Nations General Assembly to hosting the Chinese president at the White House.

stories.title: Cineplexity: The AI apocalypse feels closer than ever... Hollywood saw it coming
stories.summary: There's a long history of killer AI in cinema. Today, those works of fiction feel more real than ever.

stories.title: Worries swirl that Russia is planning to test NATO with direct attacks
stories.summary: NPR's Elissa Nadworny speaks with Kurt Volker, former U.S. ambassador to NATO, about worries that Russia's "hybrid attacks" could lead to a direct military confrontation with NATO.

stories.title: Pakistan bulldozes working class community to make way for futuristic vision of capital city
stories.summary: Pakistani authorities raze hundreds of homes of the working poor living around a beloved Sufi shrine to make way for Shanghai-style hotels.

stories.title: This Minnesota farmer is feeling the pressure of rising gas prices
stories.summary: NPR's Elissa Nadworny speaks with Kristin Duncanson, a farmer in Minnesota, about how record high fuel prices are affecting her business.
